import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t)
def nm(w):
    X=np.column_stack([one,P,P**2,1/P,np.sin(w*P),np.cos(w*P)])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    r=dP_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt),c
